title: GTS assignment catalog and app seed data
department: B&H Photo Video Guest Tech Support
purpose: Planning seed data for the log and inventory app Mike wants Claude to build.
scope_note: This is a reconstruction from available conversations, not a complete verified employer service roster. Entries describe candidate task types, not completed jobs. No operational approvals, stock counts, staff roster, or actual customer records are implied.

evidence_levels.core: Explicitly supported work area or existing work tool in our discussions. Detailed checklists are proposed standardization, not verified company procedure.
evidence_levels.discussed: A technical request we previously discussed. It supports this candidate assignment type, but does not prove it was a customer job, a completed service, or an officially offered GTS service.
evidence_levels.proposed: Suggested team process or project for the app. It is not established as a current assigned duty.

sources.description: GTS station discussion explicitly covered customer support, firmware updates, software downloads, file transfers, setup, troubleshooting, and requests for faster computers, reliable accessories, better organization, and software permissions.

Mike requested a shared GTS GPT hub for coworkers to improve productivity. Case logs, SOPs, inventory, shift handoffs, training, and commands were prior assistant proposals, not evidence of implementation.
B&H Guest Tech Support work context includes Salesforce logs and a Unix terminal. Exact Salesforce objects, fields, integrations, terminal functions, and access rights were not supplied.
Camera, lens, adapter, and firmware questions across Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, Leica, Panasonic/LUMIX, Ricoh/Pentax, Kodak, Tamron, Viltrox, TTArtisan, and 7Artisans.
Windows, Surface Laptop 5, Mac migration and login, Office, Adobe, memory/SSD upgrades, multi-monitor connections, Chromebook, iPad, and iPhone questions.
File copying, Robocopy, cloud photo downloads, Samsung T7 Shield speed, SD/CFexpress failure, DMDE recovery, BitLocker, audio-recorder recovery, and VOB/tape conversion questions.
DJI, RODE, Hollyland, SmallRig, OM System, Sony, and Tonfarb audio-device questions; Godox, Westcott, Nikon, Yongnuo, and Pentax flash and trigger questions.
Portkeys/Sony control, DJI gimbals and remotes, Pocket 3, teleprompters, RayNeo display glasses, Canon SELPHY, Sangean radio, Apple Watch, accessories, product-support and repair-location questions.
Create a detailed list of GTS assignments to help Claude build a log and inventory app/website for team efficiency.

categories.name: Customer intake, troubleshooting, and service records
categories.purpose: Capture the customer goal, investigate the problem, and leave a usable record for the next technician.
historical_examples: Customer T7 Shield transfer-speed comparison on September 8
Surface Laptop 5 setup/drive-detection investigation on September 8

categories.name: Camera and camcorder firmware
categories.purpose: Manage firmware work as a traceable change to a specific device, with its starting version and observed result.
resource_types: Charged battery or suitable power supply
historical_examples: Nikon D7100 and Z50 II direct-update questions
Leica SL2/SL3 and Ricoh GR IIIx update questions

categories.name: Lens and accessory firmware
categories.purpose: Track firmware separately for each component; a camera body update does not describe the state of its accessories.
resource_types: Lens dock or console where required

categories.name: Camera, camcorder, lens, and film-camera support
categories.purpose: Provide setup, operating instruction, and external diagnosis of imaging equipment.
historical_examples: Canon 5D Mark IV and Nikon D5200 autofocus
Canon AE-1 Program and Kodak Ektar H35

categories.name: Camera-to-phone and mobile-device connections
categories.purpose: Treat connection setup, image transfer, and remote control as separate outcomes.

categories.name: Computer setup, operating systems, and hardware troubleshooting
categories.purpose: Track operating-system work and hardware diagnosis with the original data-preservation goal attached.
historical_examples: Surface Laptop 5 drive and input detection during Windows setup
HP 255 G7 RAM and Legion SSD questions

categories.name: Software downloads, installation, and licensing support
categories.purpose: Record why software was installed, the version actually used, and whether it launched successfully.

categories.name: File transfers, backups, and device migrations
categories.purpose: Record what should move, where it should go, and how completion was checked.
resource_types: Approved copy tools such as Robocopy when applicable
historical_examples: Old Mac to new Mac Migration Assistant
Samsung T7 Shield slow at home but fast at B&H

categories.name: Storage diagnosis, data recovery, and formatting
categories.purpose: Keep source preservation, recovery output, and any authorized erasure distinct in the job record.
resource_types: Available authorized recovery tools such as DMDE
historical_examples: CFexpress Type B full-format failure and Device is not ready

categories.name: Photo, video, and legacy-media handling
categories.purpose: Track successful playback and usable output, not just a conversion process completing.

categories.name: Microphones, audio recorders, and audio connections
categories.purpose: Track transmitter pairing, receiver output, host input, and recorded audio as separate checks.
historical_examples: DJI Mic Mini with iPhone 14 Pro and Anker adapter

categories.name: Flashes, strobes, and radio triggers
categories.purpose: Treat physical fit, radio compatibility, channel/group setup, and synchronized exposure as different questions.
historical_examples: Yongnuo YN-622N II with RF603N II and Nikon SB-700
Pentax AF180FG with Ricoh GR IIIx
Godox IT32 pre-flash on Sony A7S II

categories.name: Monitors, gimbals, drones, and video accessories
categories.purpose: Track the display path separately from control, pairing, and accessory operation.
historical_examples: Portkeys LH5P-family monitor and Sony A7R V
DJI RS4 with A7 III and Ronin-S
DJI RC 2 and Mavic Air 2 topics

categories.name: Printers, small electronics, and general accessories
categories.purpose: Capture the exact requested everyday function so a simple support interaction can be logged quickly.
historical_examples: Canon SELPHY CP1500 phone printing and paper/ink mismatch

categories.name: Product research, customer instructions, and referrals
categories.purpose: Preserve useful answers with their evidence so the same question is easier to answer next time.
historical_examples: Portkeys instructions drafted for a customer

categories.name: Inventory and station operations
categories.purpose: These are proposed workflows responding to the station-equipment and organization needs you raised; exact assignments and frequencies need team confirmation.
historical_examples: June 11 requests for faster computers, reliable cables/readers/adapters/storage, organized accessories, and software permissions

categories.name: Knowledge sharing, training, and workflow improvement
categories.purpose: Build reusable team knowledge from verified work while keeping suggested procedures distinguishable from proven ones.
historical_examples: August 25 shared GTS GPT hub request
Earlier suggested SOP library, case log, handoff, training, and improvement sections

assignments.title: Assess the support request
assignments.scope: Clarify what the customer wants to accomplish, the reported problem, and the requested service.
assignments.completion_evidence: A concise goal and initial service category are recorded.

assignments.title: Identify the equipment involved
assignments.scope: Record exact make/model, relevant OS or firmware, and connected accessories; distinguish variants that affect compatibility.
assignments.completion_evidence: The actual device combination is identifiable without relying on a photo alone.

assignments.title: Diagnose and isolate a reported problem
assignments.scope: Reproduce symptoms where possible and compare settings, ports, cables, readers, and known-good equipment one variable at a time.
assignments.completion_evidence: Tests and observations are recorded; the conclusion is marked verified, suspected, or undetermined.

assignments.title: Record work in Salesforce
assignments.scope: Document the interaction in the existing work system using its actual required workflow.
assignments.completion_evidence: The external reference and a concise summary are recorded when available.

assignments.title: Document the authorized work scope
assignments.scope: Record requested operations, data to preserve, and any permission needed for changes such as a reset or format.
assignments.completion_evidence: The work scope is clear before those operations start.

assignments.title: Assign and hand off a job
assignments.scope: Name an owner, the next action, its blocker, and the equipment or station currently in use.
assignments.completion_evidence: The receiving technician can continue without repeating intake.

assignments.title: Verify and close the service record
assignments.scope: Check the customer goal, record results and limitations, and reconcile equipment used or received.
assignments.completion_evidence: Outcome and verification are saved; unresolved items remain visible.

assignments.title: Explain the result to the customer
assignments.scope: Show the relevant setup or operation and describe the next step in plain language.
assignments.completion_evidence: Instructions and any follow-up are recorded; customer demonstration is noted when performed.

assignments.title: Check firmware eligibility and update path
assignments.scope: Identify the exact device and installed version, then consult current manufacturer instructions for the applicable update route.
assignments.completion_evidence: The source, target, prerequisites, and method are recorded.

assignments.title: Download the correct firmware package
assignments.scope: Obtain the manufacturer package that matches the model and update path and identify it clearly.
assignments.completion_evidence: The package name and official source are linked to the task.

assignments.title: Perform a card-based firmware update
assignments.scope: Prepare compatible update media and follow the current model-specific procedure within the agreed scope.
assignments.completion_evidence: The camera reports the resulting firmware version, or the exact failure is recorded.

assignments.title: Perform a computer/USB firmware update
assignments.scope: Use the required updater, operating system, connection, and device mode.
assignments.completion_evidence: Updater result and the version reported by the device agree, or the discrepancy is logged.

assignments.title: Perform an app-based firmware update
assignments.scope: Use the supported app and model-specific connection method when the manufacturer provides this route.
assignments.completion_evidence: Completion and the device's resulting version are recorded.

assignments.title: Troubleshoot an update that will not start or finish
assignments.scope: Investigate package selection, prerequisites, media layout, OS compatibility, connection, power, and exact error.
assignments.completion_evidence: Successful retest or a clear escalation with attempted steps is documented.

assignments.title: Run a post-update functional check
assignments.scope: Recheck the original problem and the relevant shooting, recording, connection, or accessory function.
assignments.completion_evidence: An observed functional result is recorded separately from the version number.

assignments.title: Update compatible lens firmware
assignments.scope: Identify the lens variant and supported update method, perform the authorized update, and test its relevant functions.
assignments.completion_evidence: Lens version and observed autofocus/aperture behavior are recorded.

assignments.title: Update an electronic lens adapter
assignments.scope: Identify the exact mount adapter and revision and apply its documented firmware procedure.
assignments.completion_evidence: Adapter version and operation with the recorded camera/lens pair are documented.

assignments.title: Update an external monitor
assignments.scope: Resolve the exact monitor model before selecting firmware and follow its documented procedure.
assignments.completion_evidence: Monitor version and the required display/control functions are checked.

assignments.title: Update a gimbal, handheld camera, or controller
assignments.scope: Identify each component and the supported desktop/app update route; track components individually.
assignments.completion_evidence: Each updated component and relevant connection test are recorded.

assignments.title: Maintain accessory firmware compatibility notes
assignments.scope: Store model-specific requirements and known combinations with their source and review date.
assignments.completion_evidence: A searchable, dated note exists without treating untested combinations as compatible.

assignments.title: Set up basic camera operation
assignments.scope: Help configure the device for the customer's stated photo or video goal and explain the controls used.
assignments.completion_evidence: A representative capture or demonstration meets the stated goal.

assignments.title: Troubleshoot autofocus
assignments.scope: Check the recorded body/lens/adapter combination and applicable focus settings and behavior.
assignments.completion_evidence: Focus behavior is demonstrated or the remaining fault is isolated for referral.

assignments.title: Configure a manual lens or adapted lens
assignments.scope: Investigate lens recognition, release settings, exposure behavior, and the limits of the actual combination.
assignments.completion_evidence: A test capture documents what functions work and what remains manual.

assignments.title: Investigate disabled menus or recording-media messages
assignments.scope: Identify the camera state, media, and settings associated with unavailable options or error indicators.
assignments.completion_evidence: The menu/function works or the specific restriction is explained.

assignments.title: Investigate power, startup, or intermittent operation
assignments.scope: Compare the supported power source, connections, battery behavior, and externally observable symptoms.
assignments.completion_evidence: Findings identify a reproducible condition or the reason for service referral.

assignments.title: Investigate shutter, mirror, or camera error messages
assignments.scope: Record exact errors and compare relevant modes without presenting unperformed internal repair as a service.
assignments.completion_evidence: The result of a controlled function test and any referral are recorded.

assignments.title: Investigate overheating or unexpected shutdown
assignments.scope: Document operating conditions, mode, timing, installed firmware, and the actual warning.
assignments.completion_evidence: Findings and the next supported action are recorded without an unsupported diagnosis.

assignments.title: Check reported lens alignment or image-quality concerns
assignments.scope: Capture a consistent comparison and record the settings and observations used to assess the complaint.
assignments.completion_evidence: Reference images or findings support the conclusion and any referral.

assignments.title: Teach basic film-camera operation
assignments.scope: Identify the camera and explain applicable battery, loading, winding, release, and rewind operation.
assignments.completion_evidence: The requested operation is demonstrated within the camera's condition and loaded-film constraints.

assignments.title: Set up a camera companion app
assignments.scope: Identify the correct app for the device and guide the supported first connection.
assignments.completion_evidence: The app recognizes the intended camera.

assignments.title: Troubleshoot failed pairing or reconnection
assignments.scope: Inspect saved pairings, relevant device settings, app permissions, and the required connection sequence.
assignments.completion_evidence: Reconnection is demonstrated or the precise failure stage is documented.

assignments.title: Transfer images or video from camera to mobile device
assignments.scope: Select the agreed files and supported transfer method and check the destination.
assignments.completion_evidence: Transferred sample files open on the receiving device.

assignments.title: Set up camera remote control
assignments.scope: Configure supported remote shooting or control and test the requested function.
assignments.completion_evidence: The requested remote action is demonstrated; unsupported actions are identified.

assignments.title: Evaluate a wired phone, camera, or card-reader connection
assignments.scope: Identify connectors, host/device roles, power, and actual data compatibility for the combination.
assignments.completion_evidence: A real transfer or detection test supports the recommendation.

assignments.title: Set up a new computer
assignments.scope: Complete the agreed initial setup, basic device configuration, and requested operational checks.
assignments.completion_evidence: The user can reach the normal environment and perform the requested basic task.

assignments.title: Install or reinstall an operating system
assignments.scope: Confirm target device, edition, installation method, license entitlement, and data scope before the authorized operation.
assignments.completion_evidence: Installation state and basic function are recorded, including any unfinished setup.

assignments.title: Resolve missing installation drivers or devices
assignments.scope: Investigate storage, keyboard, mouse, and other hardware missing from setup or the installed OS.
assignments.completion_evidence: Required hardware is detected or a specific unresolved dependency is documented.

assignments.title: Assist with OS edition or activation
assignments.scope: Identify the installed edition and customer's legitimate entitlement and work through the supported activation flow.
assignments.completion_evidence: Activation/edition result is noted without storing a product key.

assignments.title: Configure operating-system update behavior
assignments.scope: Explain and set the available update options that address the user's request.
assignments.completion_evidence: Selected settings and any relevant limitations are documented.

assignments.title: Guide account or login recovery
assignments.scope: Help the device owner use the supported recovery process, distinguishing local sign-in from cloud-account credentials.
assignments.completion_evidence: Access is restored or the next official recovery step is documented; secrets are not retained.

assignments.title: Investigate boot failure or a requested reset
assignments.scope: Identify the device and symptom, preserve the agreed data scope, and use the supported diagnostic or reset route.
assignments.completion_evidence: Boot/reset outcome and data implications are recorded.

assignments.title: Assess RAM or SSD compatibility and upgrade needs
assignments.scope: Check the exact model, existing configuration, compatibility, and the support requested.
assignments.completion_evidence: Compatible requirements or a referral are documented; physical installation is a separately confirmed service.

assignments.title: Investigate overheating or cooling symptoms
assignments.scope: Record temperatures/readouts and observed fan/pump behavior using available supported diagnostics.
assignments.completion_evidence: Findings distinguish observations from an unverified failed-component diagnosis.

assignments.title: Set up or troubleshoot external displays
assignments.scope: Identify ports, adapters, display count, and system capability; test the requested arrangement.
assignments.completion_evidence: The supported display arrangement works or its limiting component is identified.

assignments.title: Troubleshoot Chromebook file or cloud-drive access
assignments.scope: Inspect the account, network, file-app behavior, and exact error using the supported account flow.
assignments.completion_evidence: Access is restored or the unresolved condition is documented.

assignments.title: Download requested software or utilities
assignments.scope: Identify a suitable official package for the device, OS, and requested use.
assignments.completion_evidence: The correct installer/source is recorded and accessible for the task.

assignments.title: Install or reinstall an application
assignments.scope: Run the agreed installation and complete its required supported configuration.
assignments.completion_evidence: The application launches or its specific installation failure is recorded.

assignments.title: Check application and operating-system compatibility
assignments.scope: Compare the actual OS/hardware with the relevant vendor requirements.
assignments.completion_evidence: The compatible option or limitation is documented with a source and date.

assignments.title: Assist with legitimate application activation
assignments.scope: Distinguish installation from license ownership and use the customer's supported activation method.
assignments.completion_evidence: Activation state is documented without retaining license keys or passwords.

assignments.title: Set up photo-viewing, camera, or device utilities
assignments.scope: Configure the tool needed to view/import files or manage the supported device.
assignments.completion_evidence: A representative file opens or the intended device is recognized.

assignments.title: Maintain a software and installer reference
assignments.scope: Catalog official sources, supported OS, last review date, access requirements, and package versions used.
assignments.completion_evidence: Staff can find a dated source and identify who maintains the entry.

assignments.title: Copy files between customer storage devices
assignments.scope: Confirm the requested files and destination and perform the agreed transfer.
assignments.completion_evidence: Destination contents and copy results are checked and documented.

assignments.title: Back up requested files to external storage
assignments.scope: Define the backup scope, check destination capacity, and copy the agreed material.
assignments.completion_evidence: The saved location, scope, errors, and verification result are recorded.

assignments.title: Migrate data between computers
assignments.scope: Plan and perform the supported transfer of agreed accounts, files, and application-related data.
assignments.completion_evidence: Requested content is checked on the new computer; applications/licensing are tracked separately.

assignments.title: Copy Windows profile folders with an appropriate utility
assignments.scope: Select the correct folders and options and track permissions, skips, and copy-log results.
assignments.completion_evidence: The requested data is accounted for, including unresolved access errors.

assignments.title: Download cloud-held files or photos to local storage
assignments.scope: Identify what is actually stored locally versus online and complete the agreed download/export.
assignments.completion_evidence: The intended local files open without relying solely on placeholders.

assignments.title: Transfer data between phones or tablets
assignments.scope: Use the supported device-migration method and monitor its connection and completion state.
assignments.completion_evidence: Agreed data categories are checked on the destination device.

assignments.title: Migrate browser data and identify application reinstall needs
assignments.scope: Separate browser sync/export, ordinary documents, application data, and installed programs.
assignments.completion_evidence: The customer knows what transferred and what still requires installation or sign-in.

assignments.title: Diagnose slow, failed, or interrupted transfers
assignments.scope: Compare the actual connection path, source/destination behavior, workload, and copy errors.
assignments.completion_evidence: The limiting factor is supported by observations or remains explicitly undetermined.

assignments.title: Verify a transfer or migration
assignments.scope: Reconcile copy-tool results with the agreed scope; open representative files and use stronger checks where the job warrants them.
assignments.completion_evidence: The verification method, samples, exceptions, and remaining gaps are recorded.

assignments.title: Diagnose a drive or card that is not detected
assignments.scope: Compare device enumeration, reader/port/cable behavior, and the recorded disk state without changing the source unnecessarily.
assignments.completion_evidence: Detection findings and tested connection paths are documented.

assignments.title: Isolate reader, cable, enclosure, or media failure
assignments.scope: Retest with compatible known-good components and record which substitutions change the result.
assignments.completion_evidence: The suspected component is supported by the actual comparison.

assignments.title: Assess whether recovery software can access the source
assignments.scope: Determine whether the source exposes the storage access the proposed recovery tool requires.
assignments.completion_evidence: Available recovery route or access limitation is recorded.

assignments.title: Run an authorized recovery scan
assignments.scope: Select the correct source and suitable scan scope, preserving source data and keeping scan details traceable.
assignments.completion_evidence: Scan progress/result and the selected recovery candidates are saved in the log.

assignments.title: Investigate deleted audio or recorder-internal data
assignments.scope: Identify recorder storage presentation and available recovery access before choosing a method.
assignments.completion_evidence: Recoverability findings are recorded without assuming every recorder exposes its internal memory.

assignments.title: Export recovered files to a separate destination
assignments.scope: Select appropriate recovery results and write recovered output away from the source being recovered.
assignments.completion_evidence: The destination, recovered counts, tool limitations, and export errors are recorded.

assignments.title: Check recovered files for actual usability
assignments.scope: Open or play representative recovered files and distinguish a listed filename from valid content.
assignments.completion_evidence: Valid, damaged, duplicate, and unchecked results are described without promising full recovery.

assignments.title: Format or initialize storage after explicit scope confirmation
assignments.scope: Verify the target and the agreed data-loss consequences before performing the requested operation.
assignments.completion_evidence: The correct device's format/initialization result and any error are documented.

assignments.title: Handle an encrypted-drive access or wipe request
assignments.scope: Distinguish unlocking with the owner's legitimate key from erasing the drive; use only the requested supported route.
assignments.completion_evidence: Access or erase outcome is recorded without retaining recovery keys.

assignments.title: Refer a recovery or hardware case beyond available capability
assignments.scope: Document source symptoms, attempted steps, and why continued work or a different service is needed.
assignments.completion_evidence: The referral reason and next action are clear.

assignments.title: Open or troubleshoot an unfamiliar media file
assignments.scope: Identify the actual file type and determine a supported playback/viewing method.
assignments.completion_evidence: The relevant file opens or the file/compatibility problem is documented.

assignments.title: Convert an existing video file to the requested format
assignments.scope: Record the source and intended playback target and perform the agreed conversion.
assignments.completion_evidence: Output video, audio, and relevant duration are checked.

assignments.title: Transfer accessible content from optical media
assignments.scope: Identify readable disc contents and copy/export the agreed material to the requested storage.
assignments.completion_evidence: Selected content is present and playable/readable at the destination.

assignments.title: Assess a tape or legacy-video conversion request
assignments.scope: Identify the tape format, available playback/capture hardware, desired output, and whether GTS can perform the work.
assignments.completion_evidence: A concrete transfer path or referral is documented; capture service availability remains explicit.

assignments.title: Organize delivered media files
assignments.scope: Place recovered, copied, or converted files into the agreed folder structure without silently replacing originals.
assignments.completion_evidence: The customer-facing delivery location and naming are clear.

assignments.title: Pair wireless microphone transmitters and receivers
assignments.scope: Identify the kit and establish the supported transmitter/receiver connection.
assignments.completion_evidence: The intended transmitters appear connected and produce a test signal.

assignments.title: Connect a microphone receiver to a camera
assignments.scope: Identify the receiver output, camera input, cable, and relevant input configuration.
assignments.completion_evidence: A camera recording contains intelligible test audio on the intended channel.

assignments.title: Connect a microphone to a phone or computer
assignments.scope: Verify the actual digital/analog connection and adapter requirements for the host.
assignments.completion_evidence: A recording in the intended host app confirms recognition and usable audio.

assignments.title: Troubleshoot missing, distorted, or incorrect-channel audio
assignments.scope: Trace the signal from source through transmitter, receiver, cable, host input, and playback.
assignments.completion_evidence: The failing stage is identified or a successful recording demonstrates the fix.

assignments.title: Set up a handheld or voice recorder
assignments.scope: Explain the requested recording controls, storage choice, playback, and supported connection.
assignments.completion_evidence: A test recording saves and plays as expected.

assignments.title: Transfer recordings to customer storage
assignments.scope: Identify the accessible recording location and copy/export the agreed files.
assignments.completion_evidence: The destination recordings play; internal-memory access limitations are documented.

assignments.title: Set up an audio-device companion app
assignments.scope: Identify the model's supported app and available connection/settings workflow.
assignments.completion_evidence: The app detects the appropriate device or its limitation is recorded.

assignments.title: Set up an on-camera flash
assignments.scope: Check the exact camera/flash combination and requested operating mode.
assignments.completion_evidence: A captured image confirms the intended flash contribution.

assignments.title: Check radio trigger compatibility
assignments.scope: Identify the actual radio ecosystem and supported combination instead of assuming devices communicate because connectors fit.
assignments.completion_evidence: Compatibility finding and its source or observed test are recorded.

assignments.title: Set channels, groups, and applicable wireless IDs
assignments.scope: Configure the available controls on the actual transmitter/receiver combination.
assignments.completion_evidence: Matching settings and a relevant trigger test are documented.

assignments.title: Set up an off-camera flash or strobe
assignments.scope: Connect the supported triggering arrangement and test the intended light.
assignments.completion_evidence: The camera triggers the intended unit during an exposure.

assignments.title: Diagnose a flash that does not fire or synchronize
assignments.scope: Compare test-button firing, camera-triggered firing, settings, power, and captured results.
assignments.completion_evidence: The failing stage is identified or synchronized capture is demonstrated.

assignments.title: Explain pre-flash or unusual flash behavior
assignments.scope: Identify the active mode and actual sequence and explain or adjust it within supported settings.
assignments.completion_evidence: The behavior and selected mode are documented with a capture test when appropriate.

assignments.title: Connect an external monitor for an image
assignments.scope: Identify the camera output, monitor input, cable, and relevant signal configuration.
assignments.completion_evidence: A usable picture appears or the exact signal failure is recorded.

assignments.title: Set up monitor-to-camera control
assignments.scope: Identify the supported wired or wireless control method and guide the customer through the device's connection process.
assignments.completion_evidence: The requested control works; credentials remain on the customer's device.

assignments.title: Set up and balance a gimbal
assignments.scope: Identify the camera/lens payload and supported mounting/balancing procedure within the actual equipment's limits.
assignments.completion_evidence: The balanced setup operates during an appropriate stationary function check.

assignments.title: Connect gimbal controls to a camera
assignments.scope: Identify the supported cable or wireless link and test the requested camera controls.
assignments.completion_evidence: Supported controls are demonstrated; unavailable functions are identified.

assignments.title: Assist with drone/controller/app setup
assignments.scope: Identify the exact aircraft/controller/phone combination and supported linking/setup process.
assignments.completion_evidence: Connection/setup outcome is recorded; an in-store setup check does not claim a flight test.

assignments.title: Connect a handheld video device to an audio accessory
assignments.scope: Configure the supported pairing or connection and verify it through a recording.
assignments.completion_evidence: The test clip contains the intended audio.

assignments.title: Set up a teleprompter or video mounting accessory
assignments.scope: Identify the physical setup, requested app/display use, and compatibility of the actual combination.
assignments.completion_evidence: The requested demonstration works or the constraint is documented.

assignments.title: Connect wearable display glasses
assignments.scope: Identify host video-output capability, cable path, power, and device controls.
assignments.completion_evidence: A working display or the unsupported connection condition is documented.

assignments.title: Connect a photo printer to a phone
assignments.scope: Set up the supported app/connection method for the requested print workflow.
assignments.completion_evidence: The phone reaches the correct printer and a print result or precise failure is recorded.

assignments.title: Diagnose printer paper or ink mismatch
assignments.scope: Identify the printer and actual paper/ink cassette sizes and installation state.
assignments.completion_evidence: The mismatch is resolved or the required compatible consumable is identified.

assignments.title: Teach radio, clock, and alarm operation
assignments.scope: Explain the requested time/date, station, alarm, enable/disable, and stop controls for the exact model.
assignments.completion_evidence: The desired settings and a relevant demonstration are documented.

assignments.title: Explain a wearable or small-device setting
assignments.scope: Locate the actual available setting and explain its behavior and limitations.
assignments.completion_evidence: The setting is demonstrated or its non-configurable limit is documented.

assignments.title: Evaluate cable, adapter, and power compatibility
assignments.scope: Record connector ends and intended function, then check data, video, audio, and power support relevant to that request.
assignments.completion_evidence: The connection recommendation is supported by a source or test.

assignments.title: Find the correct product manual or support instructions
assignments.scope: Resolve the exact model and locate the relevant manufacturer documentation.
assignments.completion_evidence: A source and the relevant procedure/topic are saved.

assignments.title: Research a requested device combination
assignments.scope: Evaluate the specific models and intended function and record supported, unsupported, or unverified status.
assignments.completion_evidence: The answer is tied to the actual combination and evidence.

assignments.title: Research product availability or discontinuation
assignments.scope: Check the available current retailer/manufacturer statements and distinguish unavailability from a confirmed discontinuation.
assignments.completion_evidence: The source, date, and limits of the conclusion are recorded.

assignments.title: Explain gray-market or support-coverage questions
assignments.scope: Explain the applicable seller/manufacturer information for the actual product and request.
assignments.completion_evidence: The explanation identifies its source and does not invent warranty coverage.

assignments.title: Locate a repair or manufacturer-support route
assignments.scope: Identify a suitable service contact for the product and issue and record how its scope was checked.
assignments.completion_evidence: The customer has a concrete referral and the reason for referral.

assignments.title: Write simple customer instructions
assignments.scope: Turn the verified device workflow into clear, short steps the customer can follow.
assignments.completion_evidence: A reusable draft is saved with the relevant model and procedure date.

assignments.title: Document a service escalation
assignments.scope: Summarize the issue, tests, evidence, requested help, and next owner.
assignments.completion_evidence: The escalation can be understood without reopening the full investigation.

assignments.title: Create and reconcile the station equipment register
assignments.scope: Identify actual assets, record location/condition/capability, and reconcile the count against what is physically present.
assignments.completion_evidence: Each counted item has a traceable record; unknowns remain unknown.

assignments.title: Label and organize cables, readers, adapters, and tools
assignments.scope: Group equipment by useful capability and identify its home location.
assignments.completion_evidence: Staff can locate a labeled item and return it to a defined place.

assignments.title: Check reusable equipment out to a job or technician
assignments.scope: Reserve or assign the specific asset or counted reusable quantity to its current use.
assignments.completion_evidence: Availability, holder, location, and related job are recorded.

assignments.title: Return and check equipment after use
assignments.scope: Record the return, condition, missing pieces, and whether it is ready for the next task.
assignments.completion_evidence: The item is either available again or visibly blocked for a stated reason.

assignments.title: Track consumable receipts and usage
assignments.scope: Record actual received, used, wasted, or adjusted quantities with units and reasons.
assignments.completion_evidence: The stock balance can be reconciled to its movement history.

assignments.title: Flag damaged, unreliable, or missing equipment
assignments.scope: Identify the affected item and its observed fault and remove it from available stock until resolved.
assignments.completion_evidence: The issue has an owner and disposition without silently deleting the item.

assignments.title: Track customer equipment received for a job
assignments.scope: When equipment is left with the team, record individual devices/accessories, condition, location, and handoff/return events.
assignments.completion_evidence: Every received item is accounted for; counter-only jobs can mark custody not taken.

assignments.title: Check workstation and station readiness
assignments.scope: Check the agreed computer, reader, cable, storage-capacity, software-access, and workspace conditions before work starts.
assignments.completion_evidence: Failures are logged as actionable station issues.

assignments.title: Clean and reset the work area
assignments.scope: Return shared accessories, organize the surface, and perform the agreed station-cleaning tasks.
assignments.completion_evidence: The station is ready for the next technician and exceptions are recorded.

assignments.title: Track workstation permissions or software-access requests
assignments.scope: Record a blocked service, the requested capability, current owner, and resolution through existing company channels.
assignments.completion_evidence: The blocker remains visible until access is available or an alternative is documented.

assignments.title: Reconcile stock and replenishment needs
assignments.scope: Perform a scheduled or triggered physical check and compare actual stock with configurable levels.
assignments.completion_evidence: Variances and proposed replenishment are recorded; orders are separate actions.

assignments.title: Create a reusable troubleshooting procedure
assignments.scope: Convert a repeatable, verified workflow into prerequisites, steps, expected results, and escalation guidance.
assignments.completion_evidence: The article has an owner, source evidence, scope, and review state.

assignments.title: Save a solved-case lesson
assignments.scope: Capture symptoms, tests, verified finding, actual fix, validation, and a concise lesson.
assignments.completion_evidence: The lesson is linked to its source case and searchable by product and symptom.

assignments.title: Maintain a shared shift-handoff view
assignments.scope: Summarize unfinished jobs, running transfers/scans, reserved equipment, and blockers for the incoming staff.
assignments.completion_evidence: Each open item has an owner and next action.

assignments.title: Track training and procedure review
assignments.scope: Record a topic, reviewer/learner, demonstration, and required follow-up without assuming formal certification.
assignments.completion_evidence: Completion or outstanding practice is recorded.

assignments.title: Maintain the GTS hub improvement backlog
assignments.scope: Record workflow problems, proposed changes, expected benefit, owner, and evidence of the result.
assignments.completion_evidence: Each project has a next step and measurable completion criterion.

project_backlog_templates.name: GTS log and inventory app
project_backlog_templates.basis: Current request; extends your earlier shared GTS hub idea
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Working shared job log, assignments, inventory movements, handoff view, and searchable procedures
project_backlog_templates.done: Staff can create, assign, update, hand off, and close a job and account for the equipment it used.

project_backlog_templates.name: Station accessory organization
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed response to the June station discussion
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Actual equipment register, labels, capability descriptions, and home locations
project_backlog_templates.done: A physical count reconciles with the register and staff can find/return the required accessories.

project_backlog_templates.name: Workstation and transfer bottleneck review
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed response to requests for faster computers and the transfer-speed cases
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Repeatable observations of common job workloads and their resource constraints
project_backlog_templates.done: The team can identify measured bottlenecks and document the result of a chosen improvement.

project_backlog_templates.name: Firmware and installer reference
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed support for existing update/download work
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Searchable official sources, model/OS requirements, owners, and verification dates
project_backlog_templates.done: Common tools and update instructions can be found and their applicability checked.

project_backlog_templates.name: Transfer and recovery job templates
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed standardization of previously discussed work
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Short templates for source/destination, scope, progress, blockers, and validation
project_backlog_templates.done: Another technician can safely understand and continue a running transfer or recovery job from its record.

project_backlog_templates.name: Compatibility and known-good equipment reference
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed support for repeated connection/adapter/trigger questions
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Records of exact tested combinations, sources, limitations, and available test accessories
project_backlog_templates.done: Staff can distinguish verified, documented, failed, and untested combinations.

project_backlog_templates.name: SOP and customer-instruction collection
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed extension of the earlier GTS hub concept
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Reviewed procedures and concise customer-facing instructions drawn from verified cases
project_backlog_templates.done: A technician can locate the applicable current procedure by model and problem.

project_backlog_templates.name: Handoff and recurring station checklist
project_backlog_templates.basis: Proposed team workflow; frequency and owners are not established
project_backlog_templates.deliverable: Open-work view plus configurable opening, closing, and stock-review templates
project_backlog_templates.done: Every unfinished job has an owner/next action and scheduled checks generate actionable exceptions.
